source.native_slice_observation_source: Native benchmark step log, nv_segment and whisper_print_timings

method.native_case_scope: Fresh worker for each fixture. Whole accelerated WAV replay with process/model startup, VAD, decode and termination.
method.native_segment_scope: whisper_print_timings total in each decode, with no extra model warmup between fixture launches.
method.ct2_case_scope: Single warmed model per thread setting. Only prepared slices, input conversion and inference; no native VAD, device capture or UI. Imports, load and warmup reported separately.
method.ct2_segment_scope: Timed after int16-to-float32 conversion, includes transcribe and iteration of results. Native and CT2 segment clocks have different boundaries.
